svg.title: Local Intent, Connected Pages, and Rental Income
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-local-intent-to-rental-income; chapter number: 1; title: Local Intent, Connected Pages, and Rental Income; subtitle: Practitioner methods from Real Estate SEO & Web Design ([xDMs5FogvQ8 @ 00:01:08]), Jacob Shireman ([Iktexen_-cc @ 00:18:56]), Manan Gupta ([_DewVbSSXe0 @ 00:06:14]), Caleb Ulku ([nW4AstHjEtc @ 00:10:29]), and Ippei - Rank and Rent SEO ([uJ0bhk9MeDE @ 00:07:50]).; chart type: process_flow; note: The sequence assembles separately attributed practices, rather than presenting a shared experiment. Ippei - Rank and Rent SEO ([uJ0bhk9MeDE @ 00:07:50]) reports continuing rent of $2,000 per month for the Grand Rapids tree-service website; Real Estate SEO & Web Design ([xDMs5FogvQ8 @ 00:03:19]) reports a $1.3 million waterfront transaction connected to a living-in-Lake-St.-Louis article.; stages: step: 01; label: Choose Converting Keywords; detail: Start with keywords that convert, prioritizing buyer and seller intent. [Real Estate SEO & Web Design — xDMs5FogvQ8 @ 00:01:08]; step: 02; label: Inspect Actual Search Results; detail: Put prospective keywords into Google and examine what comes up. [Jacob Shireman — Iktexen_-cc @ 00:18:56]; step: 03; label: Build Cluster Landing Pages; detail: Group similar keywords into clusters and build a dedicated landing page for each cluster. [Manan Gupta — _DewVbSSXe0 @ 00:06:14]; step: 04; label: Connect Category Descriptions; detail: Link each homepage category description to its corresponding detailed page, retaining topical context. [Caleb Ulku — nW4AstHjEtc @ 00:10:29]; step: 05; label: Rent or Connect Commission; detail: Ippei reports continuing website rent and separately describes connecting to a client's CRM for commission. [Ippei - Rank and Rent SEO — uJ0bhk9MeDE @ 00:07:50] [Ippei - Rank and Rent SEO — uJ0bhk9MeDE @ 00:01:06]
